Because the two FIN generators commute, a parallel superposition of the extremal relative-generator eigenvectors attains cos(n*t*Delta/2) overlap through the first pi/2 endpoint. Thus the adaptive upper bound and parallel lower bound coincide throughout the subcritical interval and at the first perfect-discrimination time.
